div.div: QNX PVM · Android GVM · Independent Vehicle MCU

g.data-meta-description: Deployment and technical dependencies for USB/DOIP OTA of three main targets. In QNX Services, updater and rpcd are peer services. updater launches the independent update_ic.sh, upgrademcu and swdl_utils executables; update_ic.sh invokes zstd. These utility dependencies are not a global Applications layer or updater-internal objects. librpcif.so is loaded by upgrademcu; libspi_client.so is loaded by rpcd and uses devctlv to spi_service below it. Android payload writes follow VirtIO-BLK to the QNX block backend; firmware staging uses NFS /otaqnx to QNX /ota. Boot HAL is a separate slot-control branch. QNX block/filesystem internals are folded at system scope. The outer MCU-file corridor avoids utility nodes and the occupied lower client-library ports. Component fills use the user's three groups: Qualcomm and Qualcomm-target adaptation in yellow, native OS/upstream implementations in green, and remaining project-specific modules in blue. The blue group includes PATEO customization and does not assert exclusive OEM copyright. Containers, hardware and storage remain neutral; edge colors retain their relationship meanings.
